decisions.reason: As a design-focused extension of the core drainage range that remained prominently marketed after its 2023 launch, the black-finish line fits the firm's aesthetic strategy and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
This shower channel is a close-to-core product with continued dedicated website presence and clear relevance for modern seamless, barrier-free bathrooms, so management would likely retain it.

Although the firm appears to have already replaced an earlier pump-assisted drainage variant, this 2024 launch still builds on the established offer and is more likely to be given time to prove itself than to be dropped immediately.
